sources.notes: Actual NPS Yukon aerial polygon image and NPS Matt Nolan Bering Land Bridge aerial photo personally inspected: dense irregular connected dark boundaries surround unequal polygon areas; not regular decorative hexagons. NPS Swanson primary morphology text distinguishes low-centered raised margins from high-centered degraded margins; low-centered subtype chosen explicitly, no contemporary trend inference.

sources.rights_note: Original generated concept used as design guidance only; not a primary factual source or texture.
sources.notes: Concept low centers/raised rims and connected irregular cells retained. Override approximately regular equal-size cells with clipped irregular Voronoi cells of unequal size, four-to-seven sides and broken orientations. One continuous manifold heightfield using shared cell boundary vertices, paired near-boundary elevated shoulders and thin lower contraction groove; centers remain below shoulders but above soil base. No floating tiled plates, deep mudcrack gaps, mixed high-centered cells, blue lakes, snow or plants. Side cut surfaces close full terrain volume.
